report_value_outliers.description: Report a document whose VALUE differs when all others agree. Off by default: sibling configs differ in values by design.
report_value_outliers.title: Report Value Outliers

missing_key_threshold.description: A key must appear in at least this fraction of documents before its absence elsewhere is reported. Guards against one file's private settings being read as everyone else's omission.
missing_key_threshold.title: Missing Key Threshold
